text: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Fire lights it, and what you do can be seen. In balance, the flame stays bright without burning out. Your warmth and wit reach people at the moment they count.

Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Water makes it flow, and what goes in comes back later as instinct. In balance, the water runs clear all the way down. Your instinct is ready when a choice arrives.

Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Fire makes it warm, so you recover by doing. In balance, the fire stays lit through a long week. Working alone or racing a friend, you finish with fuel to spare.

Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Earth makes it slow and solid, made to last. In balance, the gate opens at its own steady pace. You let each piece ripen, and it is worth the wait.

Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Metal makes it exact, each thing finished before it leaves you. In balance, the gate opens when a piece is ready and closes when you need to rest. You come to each new piece fresh.

Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water makes it flow, and what you feel comes out. In balance, the water finds its level. You reach people in good time and keep enough for yourself.

You follow rules even with people who need an exception. Being fair by the book feels safer to you than bending it to be kind, and you hand them policy instead of a decision. You keep from them the exception that was yours to give.

Where you avoid change, you avoid it for others too. The old plan is the one you trust, and you keep the people close to you inside it instead of letting them change it. You put off the new starts they wanted to make.

Finished, you look for the next race before the last cools. Staying put feels like being passed, and only the race ahead counts for you. You race the next one instead of keeping the win, and the win was the point.

Your biggest bets land on other people too. Going big matters more to you than going safe, and the shared money rides on your nerve. You set the size of a risk that the people who pooled with you have to live with.
